description: This header file defines the interface for registering, updating, and unregistering cron events in a software system. It includes function prototypes for managing cron-based callbacks, a typedef for the callback function, and documentation related to cron schedules.

methods.name: registerForCronEvent
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when a specific cron event occurs, with optional schedule details.

methods.name: updateCronEventSchedule
methods.description: Updates the schedule for an existing cron event identified by its name.

methods.name: unregisterForCronEvent
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered cron event callback and optionally removes the cron entry.
